rationale: GPN has experienced an extraordinary gap down of roughly 10% from prior close ($100.23 to open $100.00, then collapsing to a low of $87.11), suggesting a major fundamental catalyst (likely an earnings miss or guidance cut) driving extreme selling pressure.
